meta.name: behavioral-modes
meta.description: AI operational modes (brainstorm, implement, debug, review, teach, ship, orchestrate). Use to adapt behavior based on task type.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据任务类型切换AI工作模式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在不同任务间快速调整AI行为
copy.tagline_en: Switch AI working modes based on task type
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly adjust AI behavior across different tasks

howto.what: Claude会根据任务类型自动采用不同行为模式：构思时探索多种方案，编码时直接写高效代码，调试时系统分析，审查时分类优化，教学时循序渐进，发布时检查稳定性。
howto.when: 当你说出“what if”、“build”、“not working”等关键词时自动匹配对应模式；也可以用斜杠命令如 /brainstorm 手动切换。

say.note: 切换到构思模式，Claude会探索多种方案。
切换到调试模式，Claude会系统分析并定位根因。
切换到审查模式，Claude会分类给出改进建议。

howto.what_en: Claude adapts its behavior based on task type: brainstorming explores alternatives, implementing writes production-quality code, debugging systematically finds root causes, reviewing categorizes feedback, teaching builds from fundamentals, and shipping checks stability.
howto.when_en: Automatically triggered by keywords like 'what if', 'build', 'not working', etc., or manually via slash commands like /brainstorm.

say_en.note: Switches to brainstorm mode for divergent thinking.
Switches to debug mode for systematic investigation.
Switches to review mode for categorized feedback.
